Full summary: PHASE 1 COMPLETE (server query layer, Tasks 1-6, commits 262ce0f..635248c on dashboard-scale-redesign). All 6 endpoints live-verified against the 5k fixture: /api/index 346KB gzipped/41ms for 10k rows; graph summary 13ms; health-report 64ms cold/0.4ms cached; neighborhood correctly caps a hub to limit with per-type overflow. Phase 2 (client index store + virtualized lists) starts next, inline.
Findings: Wire size note: /api/index at 5k+5k rows is 346KB gzipped — above the spec's ~200KB estimate but well within budget; first-paint target unaffected (41ms server time).; Subagent-driven phase retro: 6 tasks, 6 reviews, 1 Critical caught and fixed (depth-2 overflow shape), 2 plan defects caught by review (wiring snippet bug, 4-key counts contract), 1 report inaccuracy caught (test count). The two-stage review loop earned its cost; implementer reports alone would have shipped 3 of those 4 defects.
